verses.text: A prophet, or someone who explains dreams, may appear among you and promise you a miraculous sign or wonder.
Even if the sign or wonder he spoke of happens, and he says, "Let us follow other gods," gods you have not known, "and let us worship them,"
do not listen to that prophet or dreamer. The LORD your God is testing you, to find out whether you love him with all your heart and all your soul.
Follow the LORD your God and fear him. Keep his commands and obey him. Serve him and hold tightly to him.

That prophet or dreamer must be put to death, because he has taught you to rebel against the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt and set you free from slavery. He tried to turn you away from the way the LORD your God commanded you to live. You must get rid of this evil from among you.

Your own brother, your son or daughter, the wife you love, or your closest friend may secretly try to lead you astray. They may say, "Let us go and worship other gods," gods that neither you nor your ancestors have known,
gods of the peoples around you, whether near or far, from one end of the earth to the other.
Do not give in to them or listen to them. Do not feel sorry for them. Do not spare them or protect them.
You must certainly put them to death. Your hand must be the first to strike them, and then the hands of all the people.
Stone them to death, because they tried to turn you away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt, the land where you were slaves.
Then all Israel will hear about it and be afraid, and no one among you will do such an evil thing again.
You may hear that in one of the towns the LORD your God is giving you to live in,
some wicked men have appeared among you and led the people of their town astray, saying, "Let us go and worship other gods," gods you have not known.
Then you must look into it, search it out, and ask questions carefully. If it is true and it is proven that this hateful thing has been done among you,
you must kill all the people of that town with the sword. Destroy it completely, with everyone in it and its animals too.

Gather everything taken from the town into the middle of its public square, and burn the whole town and everything in it as an offering to the LORD your God. It must remain a pile of ruins forever. It must never be rebuilt.

Do not keep any of the things set apart for destruction. Then the LORD will turn away from his fierce anger. He will show you mercy and kindness, and he will make you grow in number, as he promised your ancestors.
He will do this if you obey the LORD your God, keep all his commands that I am giving you today, and do what is right in the eyes of the LORD your God.
